messages:
Ava (Acme): hey team, we're seeing a bunch of errors in our embedding pipeline since ~09:13 UTC. Our similarity scorer crashes with 'dimension mismatch' — client expects 768 but the API is returning 1536 vectors. nothing changed on our side. any ideas?

Ava (Acme): example response (stripped):
```json
{
  "request_id": "req_01Fxyz",
  "model": "redwood-embed-large-v1",
  "embedding": [ /* 1536 floats */ ]
}
```

Ava (Acme): we're calling /v1/embeddings with our project token in header: `X-Project-Token: proj_live_abc` but we also pass `X-Org-Key: org_live_123` (the org-level key for billing). Could that be causing model selection to prefer org defaults?

Sam (Support): thanks @Ava, sorry for the trouble. can you paste the request_id(s) and a minimal curl? also which SDK/version you use? we'll escalate immediately. :eyes:

Ava (Acme): sure — request ids: `req_01Fxyz`, `req_01Fxyy`, `req_01Fxzz`. curl we used: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer proj_live_abc" \\n  -H "X-Project-Token: proj_live_abc" \\n  -H "X-Org-Key: org_live_123" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"input":"hello world"}'
```

Sam (Support): got it. forwarding to eng — pinging @Priya and @Lars.

Priya (Eng): looking. we've seen a similar spike in the router logs for org `org_live_123` — it looks like the routing layer applied the org-level default model (redwood-embed-large-v1) instead of honoring the project-scoped default (redwood-embed-small-v1). reproduction looks possible when both `X-Org-Key` and `X-Project-Token` are present and the project header parsing happens after org precedence change in the last deploy.

Priya (Eng): quick repro I ran locally:
```bash
# older behavior (expected): project header wins
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer proj_live_TEST" \\n  -H "X-Project-Token: proj_live_TEST" \\n  -H "X-Org-Key: org_live_TEST" \\n  -d '{"input":"test","model":"redwood-embed-small-v1"}'
# returns 768-dim vector

# current problematic routing (observed): project header ignored, org default used
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer proj_live_TEST" \\n  -H "X-Project-Token: proj_live_TEST" \\n  -H "X-Org-Key: org_live_TEST" \\n  -d '{"input":"test"}'
# returns 1536-dim vector (redwood-embed-large-v1)
```

Lars (ML Infra): confirming — the model-selection cache key currently canonicalizes on `org` when the org header is present. there's a cache TTL (5m) and a short window where project-specific choices are masked. normally the router merges project settings post-cache, but a regression in the last rollout changed the merge order. causes dimension mismatch when customers expect small->768 but get large->1536.

Lars (ML Infra): mitigation options:
- purge the selection cache for affected org: `infra cache-purge embeddings-model-selection --org org_live_123`
- ask customers to explicitly set `model` in the request body (temp workaround)
- quick canary rollback of the router change (we can do immediate rollback if needed)

Priya (Eng): I'm opening ENG-5278 to add a guard: if `X-Project-Token` present, it must take precedence over org defaults for model selection, regardless of cache. will add an automatic cache-invalidation on header mismatch. ETA for patch and canary: ~2h.

Sam (Support): customer-facing plan to propose to Ava:
1) immediate: ask them to set `{"model":"redwood-embed-small-v1"}` in the request body (or remove `X-Org-Key` and use project key only) — preserves scoring correctness.
2) infra: purge cache for org `org_live_123` (we will do this now).
3) eng: rolling fix + canary and monitor; we'll confirm once the router fix is live.

Sam (Support): @Lars can you run the cache purge now and paste the job id?

Lars (ML Infra): running purge: `infra cache-purge embeddings-model-selection --org org_live_123 --force`
Job id: `job_2026-09-15-99`
Started: 1768459950
Completed: 1768459975
Affected keys: 432

deploy-bot: a canary rollback for routing change has been triggered by @Priya — deploy id `deploy-rollback-2026-09-15-2` — status: in_progress

Priya (Eng): canary is up (10% traffic) with old routing; initial validation: project-scoped requests now hit `redwood-embed-small-v1`. monitoring metrics for dimension mismatch errors.

Sam (Support): messaging back to customer (draft):
> Hi Ava — we've identified a routing regression that caused org-level defaults to override project defaults when both headers were present. For a short time some requests used `redwood-embed-large-v1` (1536 dims) instead of your expected `redwood-embed-small-v1` (768 dims). We've purged caches for your org and rolled a canary rollback. Immediate workaround: set the `model` field to `redwood-embed-small-v1` in your request body or remove the `X-Org-Key` header. We'll follow up once the router patch is fully deployed. Apologies for the disruption.

Ava (Acme): thanks everyone — applied the `model` override and removed the org header for now. errors dropped immediately. appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:

Priya (Eng): followups for infra/qa: add unit tests for header precedence, add e2e with both headers present and varying cache states, and create an alert when embedding dim mismatches spike > 0.5% bucketed per org.

Lars (ML Infra): created infra task INFRA-983 to expose a `cache-inspect` endpoint for operations (useful for similar incidents).

Sam (Support): updating the ticket and handing off to eng for the rollback verification. I'll send a post-incident note after final deploy.

Ava (Acme): appreciate it — will reopen if anything else crops up.

Priya (Eng): marking ENG-5278 as in-progress. ETA for full rollout: 3 hours, will post updates here. :rocket:
